The '''''Judicator''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the ship operated in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].
